scenes.title: Coupe [natation]
scenes.description: A press photograph from 1911 by Agence Rol, held by the Bibliothèque nationale de France, département Estampes et photographie, EI-13 (108).
scenes.explanation: While basic glass goggles existed, the modern rubber-strapped swimming goggle with a single band did not become a common, recognizable object until decades after 1911.

source.description: Référence bibliographique : Rol, 15999 Appartient à l’ensemble documentaire : Pho20Rol

scenes.title: Stavern kirke
scenes.description: A photograph from 1964 showing Stavern kirke, held by the National Library of Norway and in the public domain. The record does not name a photographer.
scenes.explanation: Floating solar panels were not deployed until the 2010s, so one cannot exist in a 1964 photograph.
scenes.credit: Mittet & Co. AS, Brun, Jacob Reidar via National Library of Norway

scenes.title: Sarpsborg tekniske skole
scenes.description: A photograph from 1968, held by the National Library of Norway, shows Sarpsborg tekniske skole. The record does not name a photographer.
scenes.explanation: Bicycle helmets of this hard-shell type were not in common use in 1968; they became widespread only in the 1970s and later.
scenes.credit: Mittet & Co. AS, Hilsen, Kristian via National Library of Norway

scenes.title: NSB, E.L.8
scenes.description: A photograph from the NSB, E.L.8 collection, dated 13 March 1948 and in the public domain, held by the National Library of Norway. The record does not state what the photograph depicts, where it was taken, or who took it.
scenes.explanation: Standardized container twistlock flat wagons only entered railway service in the 1960s, so this vehicle cannot exist in a photograph taken in 1948.
scenes.credit: Mittet & Co. AS via National Library of Norway

scenes.title: Maquette du monument qui sera élevé à la mémoire des soldats canadiens tombés à Ypres de Walter Allward (Cl. Keystone)
scenes.description: A press photograph from January 1922 by Agence Rol shows the model of the monument to be erected to the memory of the soldiers fallen at Ypres by Walter Allward, credited to Keystone. It is held by the Bibliothèque nationale de France, département Estampes et photographie.
scenes.explanation: Telescoping boom lifts with hydraulic arms did not exist in 1922.
